title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via binary_to_term (erlang) — review required
description: In erlang, binary_to_term performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The erlang-specific remedy is data-only decoding via binary_to_term/2 with the [safe] option.
applicability: erlang codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through binary_to_term; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
